## Facilities
- Bharatanatyam classes
- Theory & practice
- Salangai pooja
- Arangetram
- Dance dramas & productions
- Fusion & thematic pieces
- Classes for children
- Performances in India & abroad

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Nrithyanjali School of Arts?
No. 17, Kanni Street, Jafferkhanpet, Ashok Nagar, Chennai 600 083.

### What facilities does Nrithyanjali School of Arts have?
Bharatanatyam classes, Theory & practice, Salangai pooja, Arangetram, Dance dramas & productions, Fusion & thematic pieces, Classes for children, Performances in India & abroad.

### Who teaches the classes?
Smt. Kaveri Ramesh, Founder and Director, a disciple of Guru Sri S. Aravindan of Barathiya Kala Bhavanam Koothambalam.

### Do students perform?
Yes. Smt. Kaveri Ramesh has completed arangetram for 15 students and salangai pooja for 150.

### How do I join Nrithyanjali School of Arts?
Send us your preferred date on WhatsApp from this page, or call +91 94441 63290. We'll call you for an interview with you and your parents.
